criteria.label: Political visual framing
criteria.positive: Rate visible political or advocacy framing from readable words or the arrangement of symbols. Describe literal features without assigning unprinted names.
criteria.low_label: No visible political or advocacy cue
criteria.high_label: Explicit, central political or advocacy framing

criteria.label: Commercial promotion
criteria.positive: Rate explicit promotion through readable offers, prices, branding or directed product presentation. Ordinary objects alone provide no promotional cue.
criteria.high_label: Explicit, central selling or promotional appeal

criteria.label: Explicit call to action
criteria.positive: Is an explicit request to act visibly present? Use true for a readable request or unambiguous depicted invitation, false for assessable absence, and null for a potentially present request that is unreadable or ambiguous.
criteria.negative: Expressive poses alone do not establish a request.

criteria.label: Us-versus-them framing
criteria.positive: Rate explicit division through readable us-versus-them wording or a clearly oppositional arrangement. Different symbols alone do not demonstrate hostility.

criteria.label: Depicted emotional intensity
criteria.positive: Rate the intensity depicted through visible expressions, gestures, posture or contrast. Describe those cues rather than claiming people's actual feelings or predicting audience reactions.

criteria.label: Visual emphasis
criteria.positive: Rate visual emphasis from contrast, scale, placement and focal structure. Report those features without predicting audience effects.

criterion_1.reason: Flags and national shirt prominently displayed with Eiffel Tower background

criterion_2.reason: No readable branding or promotional text

criterion_3.reason: Expressive poses without explicit textual request

criterion_4.reason: Different flags present without explicit divisive wording

criterion_5.reason: Shouting faces and crying gesture show strong intensity

criterion_6.reason: Central placement of Eiffel Tower, flags, and foreground figure
